meta.title: Costa Nativa · Architect-designed house with private pool, Brasilito, Guanacaste
meta.description: A calm two-bedroom house with a private pool, set in five thousand square metres of Guanacaste forest, three minutes from Playa Brasilito. Sleeps five. Book on Airbnb.
meta.ogAlt: Costa Nativa at dusk, the lit pool reflecting the open living space

hero.title: A house that opens to the trees.
hero.subtitle: Two bedrooms, a private pool and five thousand square metres of forest, three minutes from Playa Brasilito.

opening.body:
There is a moment, usually on the second morning, when you stop reaching for your phone. The house is quiet except for the birds, the doors are already open, and the pool is holding the shape of the trees above it.

That is what Costa Nativa is for.

house.title: Open, and then more open.
house.body: The living space has no hard edge. Glass doors slide back until the kitchen, the sofa and the terrace are one room and the breeze moves through all of it. High ceilings, light from three sides.

pool.title: The centre of the day.
pool.body: In the shade of the trees, a few steps from the table and the grill. Coffee out here in the morning. Not moving very much in the afternoon.

setting.title: Three minutes to the water.
setting.body: Playa Brasilito has a small town square, good restaurants, boards and boat trips. Playa Conchal, the beach of crushed shells, is around the headland. The house sits in Catalina Cove, a gated community with round-the-clock security.
setting.distancesNote: Approximate driving times. They depend on the season and the road.

evening.line: This is the hour you came for.
evening.body: The doors stay open, the light goes, and the pool turns the terrace into the best room in the house.

design.title: Designed, not decorated.
design.body: Drawn in 2021 by the Costa Rican architects Murillo + Sanabria, around a private collection of work by the artist Jacques Hervot. The white walls are there so the paintings can speak. You will find them in every room.
design.label: Jacques Hervot · private collection

rooms.title: Built for sleeping well.
rooms.body: Blackout shades, noise insulation, air conditioning and premium cotton linens in both bedrooms. Five people, comfortably.
rooms.bedroomTwo: Second bedroom: queen bed and single bed

details.title: What you get.
amenities: Roku Streambar: Netflix, Disney+, HBO Max, Prime
notes: The laundry is available on stays of more than one week.
The community asks for no parties or loud music after 10pm.
